title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face
tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

judge.summary: The output is a polished professional headshot that preserves her recognisable features, apparent age, skin texture, curls and expression.

must_haves.item: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
must_haves.why: The eye shapes and spacing, nose, closed-mouth smile, jawline and overall facial proportions closely match the source.

must_haves.item: Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
must_haves.why: She appears the same age, with visible skin texture on the forehead and cheeks and natural detail around the eyes and mouth.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
must_haves.why: Her dark shoulder-length curls and subtle closed-mouth smile are retained.

must_haves.item: The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
must_haves.why: The sweater is replaced with a navy blazer over a white blouse.

must_haves.item: The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.
must_haves.why: A neutral gray backdrop replaces the park, and soft directional lighting provides flattering highlights and natural facial shading.
